final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT o.ordertune AS tune, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS c FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark GROUP BY o.ordertune), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(c) AS tot FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.tune AS tune, s1.c AS c, CAST(s1.c AS REAL) / NULLIF(s2.tot, 0) AS r FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.tot IS NOT NULL), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(r) AS a FROM s3), s5 AS (SELECT s3.tune, s3.c, s3.r, s3.r - s4.a AS d FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.a IS NOT NULL WHERE s3.r > s4.a) SELECT SUM(c), AVG(r), AVG(d) FROM s5
